_readme: Card panels whose highlight is a region grown on the parent bone, not the
atlas object the mapping names. Read by renderMusclePanels.py --regions.
Rules are landmarkRegions.py rules (same kinds as landmark-regions.rules.json);

rule._why: The lateral malleolus is the distal end of the fibula. The atlas's own 'Lateral malleolus' object is a flat marker disc beside the bone.
The medial malleolus is the process of the tibia that hangs below the plafond; the lowest slab of the tibia is it.
